title: Composer accepts unstable packages globally
description: composer.json declares a `minimum-stability` below stable. Every constraint in the project can resolve to a prerelease or a development build, which sits outside most advisory ranges.
remediation: Keep `minimum-stability` at `stable` and mark the few packages that need otherwise.
limitation: It matches a `minimum-stability` below stable in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
